items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: No, I never heard Baby down here. I heard him down here after George went to New York with George. Yeah, but I didn't know him before that time.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, at Larry Theater, yeah. Wonderful. He was one of them. Yeah. Zuri, I remember Zuri, but he was at Larry.
Remember him hearing Baby Dodds down here?
No, I never heard Baby down here. I heard him down here after George went to New York with George. Yeah, but I didn't know him before that time.
